omm_stream.ErrorContribResponse

Response of a contribution for which the server returned an Error message.

Available as lseg.data.delivery.omm_stream.ErrorContribResponse.

Syntax

ErrorContribResponse(message: dict)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
message dict Yes Message received from the server.

Properties

Property Description
ack_id Acknowledgement ID of the contribution, if present in the message.
debug Debug information from the message, empty if absent.
error Error text of the message, empty if absent.
is_success Always False, the server returned an error.
nak_code Negative acknowledgement code from the message, empty if absent.
nak_message Always empty.
type Type of the response message.
